name: team
description: Virtual engineering team: spec and plan with a human approval gate, then autonomous TDD-gated implement, QA, and two-axis review. Hard red-green-refactor enforcement via deterministic hooks, a committed per-project knowledge base (invariants with the incidents that bought them), and optional code-review-graph integration. Stack-agnostic: Laravel, Symfony, Node, TypeScript, Next.js, Python, Go, Rust and more via per-project config.
